title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on whether university canteens should be open to the public. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Recently, our university has been collecting opinions on whether campus canteens should welcome outside visitors. In my view, opening them to the public is a wise move that benefits both the campus and the community. For one thing, university canteens usually offer clean and affordable meals, so opening them can relieve the dining pressure faced by nearby residents and office workers who struggle to find cheap lunches. For another, the extra income earned from these visitors allows canteens to upgrade their equipment and even lower prices for students. Admittedly, more diners may cause crowding and raise safety concerns; however, such problems can be eased by setting fixed visiting hours and checking visitors at the gate. Therefore, I firmly believe that a properly managed open canteen is worthwhile. As long as student needs come first, sharing this resource makes our university a warmer part of society.
keyPoints: 开门见山表态。首段用 In my view, opening them to the public is a wise move 一句直接 亮牌，落实了『点题句加表态句』方法，开头即满足 express your view。
两理由加让步。段内 For one thing… For another… 摆出便民、增收两条理由，并落到 nearby residents、lower prices for students 等具体场景，再用 Admittedly…however… 让步回应拥 挤与安全，论证有据。
重申并升华。结尾 Therefore, I firmly believe… 重申立场，末句 As long as student needs come first 把话题拔高到共享意义，与开头呼应形成闭环。
